layout.demoBanner: Demo mode: every account here is a pseudonymous test account.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.passwordForm: Sign in with e-mail and password
signIn.lostAccess: Lost access to your sign-in methods?

secondFactor.title: Confirm your sign-in
secondFactor.text: Enter the code of your authenticator app, or use a passkey or a recovery code.

invitation.title: Accept the invitation
invitation.text: Continue to set up the sign-in of your new account.
invitation.requestText: Enter your e-mail address. An invitation link reaches addresses that may create an account.
invitation.sent: If the address can receive an invitation, we have sent a link to it.

enroll.title: Set up your sign-in
enroll.text: Your account needs a sign-in method. A passkey signs you in with your device's screen lock and resists phishing.
enroll.recoveryTitle: Set up a new sign-in method
enroll.recoveryText: Your recovery succeeded. Set up a new sign-in method for your account.
enroll.passkeyText: Your browser asks for your device's screen lock or your security key.
enroll.passwordText: The authenticator app is the second step after a password. Choose the password first.

recovery.title: Recover access
recovery.startText: Recovery needs a link that we send by e-mail and one of your saved recovery codes.
recovery.sent: If the address belongs to an account, we have sent a link to it.
recovery.verifyText: Enter one of your saved recovery codes. Afterwards you set up a new sign-in method.

signedOut.title: You are signed out
signedOut.body: Your session has ended here and at your sign-in provider.

errors.signInFailed: Sign-in failed. Check your details and try again.
errors.passkeyCancelled: The passkey request was closed or timed out. Try again or choose another way to sign in.
errors.linkInvalid: This link is invalid or has expired. Please ask for a new one.
errors.linkRequired: An account with this e-mail address exists. Sign in to it and connect this account in your security settings.
errors.recoveryFailed: The recovery code did not match, or the link has expired.
errors.stepUpFailed: The confirmation failed. Please try again.
errors.credentialsRequired: Enter the user name and the password.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: No page exists at this address.

forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.text: Your roles do not include this area.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.text: The page could not be shown. Please try again later.

account.title: Security settings
account.demoNotice: Demo accounts have no security settings.

factors.lastFactor: You cannot remove your only second factor. Add another one first.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.deviceOnly: Stored on this device or security key only
passkeys.removeText: The passkey “{{name}}” no longer signs you in.
passkeys.nicknameHint: At most 60 characters. The name helps you to recognize the passkey in this list.
passkeys.adminRequired: Your role requires a passkey. Add a passkey to your account.

totp.title: Authenticator app
totp.disabled: No authenticator app is set up.
totp.added: The authenticator app was set up.
totp.removeText: Its codes no longer confirm your sign-in.
totp.scan: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, or enter the key by hand.
totp.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app

recovery.title: Recovery codes
recovery.low: Few codes are left. Create new codes.
recovery.regenerateText: Your old recovery codes stop working.
recovery.usedNotice_one: You signed in with a recovery code. {{count}} code is left. Create new codes below.
recovery.usedNotice_other: You signed in with a recovery code. {{count}} codes are left. Create new codes below.
recovery.panelText: Each code works once. Keep the codes in a safe place; you need one if you lose access to your sign-in methods.
recovery.copyFailed: The codes could not be copied. Use the download.

password.title: Password
password.changed: The password was changed. Your other sessions have ended.
password.external: This account signs in through a connected provider and has no password sign-in.
password.guidance: Use at least 15 characters. A passphrase of several unrelated words reaches that length. Avoid well-known phrases, the name of this service and your own name or e-mail address.

errors.too_short: This password has fewer than 15 characters.
errors.too_long: This password has more than 128 characters.
errors.common: This password is on a list of commonly used passwords. Choose a different one.
errors.context: This password contains a word connected to this service, your name or your e-mail address. Choose a different one.
errors.breached: This password appears in known data breaches. Choose a different one.
errors.current_invalid: The current password is not correct.

email.title: E-mail address
email.sent: We have sent a confirmation link to the new address. The address changes when you open it.
email.confirmText: The new address replaces the current address of your account.
email.signInFirst: Sign in to the account first. The button works again once you are signed in.
email.signInNewTab: Sign in in a new tab

identities.title: Connected accounts
identities.confirmLink: After the connection, this account signs in with {{label}} only. Your passkeys, your authenticator app and your recovery codes then serve as the second step after {{label}}. Sign-in with a password, sign-in with a passkey alone and recovery through an e-mail link end for this account.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.promptText: Your sign-in methods changed. Ending your other sessions signs out every other device.

stepUp.title: Confirm it is you
stepUp.text: This change needs a recent confirmation with a second factor.
stepUp.codeLabel: Six-digit code of the authenticator app
stepUp.unavailable: This session has no second factor for the confirmation.

errors.lastFactor: You cannot remove your last second factor.
errors.adminPasskeyRequired: Your role requires at least one passkey.
errors.totpAlreadyEnabled: An authenticator app is already set up.
errors.passwordRequired: The authenticator app needs a password first.
errors.linkRequired: An account with this e-mail address exists. Sign in to it and connect this account in your security settings.
errors.identityInUse: This sign-in belongs to another account.
errors.providerAlreadyLinked: Your account is already connected to this provider.
errors.registrationFailed: The passkey could not be created. Please try again.
errors.passkeyExists: This device or security key already holds a passkey for your account.
errors.invalidCode: The code is not correct. Check the time on your device and try again.
errors.stepUpNotAvailable: A confirmation at the provider is not available.
errors.passwordRejected: The new password was not accepted. The reason is shown below the field.

errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Try again in {{minutes}} minutes.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

programs.title: Programs
programs.loadFailed: The programs could not be loaded. Please try again later.

loadFailed.title: Program not available
loadFailed.notFound: This program does not exist or is not published.
loadFailed.text: The program could not be loaded. Please try again later.

player.saveFailed: Your last change could not be saved. Please check your connection.

path.label: Path
path.explanation: Both paths cover every lesson. On the short path, explanations start collapsed and open when an answer shows a gap. On the full path, they start open.

station.pending: This station is not available in this version yet.
station.completeFailed: The module could not be completed. Please try again.
station.examsOpen: Pass these exams before you complete the module:
station.completedAnnouncement: Module complete. Of its objectives, {{evidenced}}, {{practised}} and {{open}}.

items.submitFailed: The answer could not be sent. Please try again.

slot.previewEmpty: Choose an option for each part to see the result.

items.revealed: The explanation in this lesson is open now:

exam.rule_zero: The exam passes when every answer is correct.
exam.rule_one: The exam passes when no core question is answered wrong and at most one answer is wrong.
exam.rule_other: The exam passes when no core question is answered wrong and at most {{count}} answers are wrong.
exam.alreadyPassed: You have passed this exam. A new attempt is possible at any time.
exam.lastFailed: Your last attempt did not pass. A new attempt is possible at any time.
exam.failed: The exam could not be submitted. Please try again.

outcome.failedCore: Not passed: a core question is answered wrong.
outcome.failedErrors: Not passed: {{wrong}} answers are wrong, more than the {{max}} this exam allows.

completion.counts: Of the objectives of this topic, {{evidenced}}, {{practised}} and {{open}}.

legend.evidenced: An exam, an attendance certificate or a recorded practice answer shows the objective.
legend.practised: You answered a practice item for the objective.
